Along with [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] had a '''second moon''' which [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] around it.

==Description==
Mandalore's second [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was one of two [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] that orbited the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] people. Located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], more specifically within [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore space]], the second moon would orbit Mandalore just as the latter would orbit around the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Mandalore (star)/Legends|sun]].<ref name="TEA" /> It could not always be seen on the planet's surface, though.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mandalore's second moon was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a galactic reference book [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. Published [[August 18]], [[2009]], it was the first source to state Mandalore was orbited by two [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="TEA" /> However unlike Mandalore's second moon, Concordia would go on to be explored in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] episode "[[The Mandalore Plot]]."<ref name="TMP">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref>
